runtime_equations_and_rules.task3_reset: gird=0, cirr=0, qssdi=0, dt_irr_event=1 before fixed-event decision
runtime_equations_and_rules.ssdi_sum: qssdisum increases by the sum over the SSDI node range
runtime_equations_and_rules.cursor: nirri increments by one after event activation

translation_rules.surface_units: irdepth converted mm to cm; irrate converted mm/hour to cm/day
translation_rules.ssdi_depth_distribution: before unit conversion, irdepth for type 2 is divided by the number of SSDI nodes
translation_rules.ssdi_rate_distribution: irrate is not divided by the number of SSDI nodes and is applied at every SSDI node
translation_rules.duration_limit: irdepth/irrate must not exceed one day
translation_rules.ssdi_total_water_identity: node_count * per_node_rate * duration equals original total irrigation depth
